user_visible_outcome: Admin can upload a valid JPEG or PNG without a misleading malformed-file rejection or silent loss of the private file.
user_journeys: An authenticated Admin uploads a photograph to an unpublished Chapter with required alt text and an optional caption.
non_negotiable_quality: Valid private photographs are not deleted when the server-side decoder/runtime fails.
Invalid type or byte-format mismatches continue to be rejected.
Operational logs contain no image bytes, captions, alt text, storage path, or family identity.
realistic_harms_prevented: A valid private family photograph is silently discarded because image-verification infrastructure fails.
The author receives a false malformed-file diagnosis and cannot distinguish it from a service failure.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Sharp is explicitly externalized for the Node server bundle used on Vercel.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: Vercel production build for the release commit completes successfully.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The finalizer distinguishes an invalid image from a decoder/runtime failure and preserves the private object for the latter.
A verifier failure produces a safe operational diagnostic without logging private content and a truthful user message.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: Inspect the verifier-failure branch in src/lib/media/finalize-upload.ts.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The current production deployment reaches READY and an Admin retests one original JPEG upload.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: Vercel deployment status plus owner live Admin upload check.

non_goals: Change family or Admin authentication, data schema, Storage policy, media visibility, content publishing, video upload, or photo-editing workflow.
Add a dependency, paid service, migration, or permanent image-processing queue.
Retry or delete any previously failed upload.
simplest_acceptable_approach: Externalize the existing Sharp dependency for the server runtime and return typed verification outcomes so infrastructure failures are logged safely and retained instead of misreported as malformed files.
verification: Vercel runtime logs after one owner re-test
